name: rate_limiter
prompt: Create solution.py defining class SlidingWindowLimiter(limit, window) with allow(key, t) -> bool. It implements a sliding-window rate limit per key: a request at time t is allowed if fewer than limit ALLOWED requests for that key occurred in the half-open interval (t - window, t] (so a request exactly window seconds ago no longer counts). Allowed requests are recorded; denied requests are NOT recorded and do not count. Keys are independent. Calls arrive with non-decreasing t. Times may be floats. Verify it by running code, then call finish.
